sentences.japanese: 共通の利害をもった両当事者がけんか腰でいたとき、彼が間に入って、いさかいにけりをつけた。
sentences.english: Two different parties with common interests were on the warpath when he cut in to settle the dispute.

sentences.japanese: 家事をすべて終えてから、彼女はソファーに腰をおろしてテレビを見た。
sentences.english: Having finished all her housework, she sat down on the sofa to watch television.

sentences.japanese: もうそろそろ腰を落ち着けてもいいんじゃないの。
sentences.english: It's about time you settled down for good.

sentences.japanese: ベンチに腰かけたとたんに、ペンキが塗りたてなのに気づいた。
sentences.english: I had hardly sat down on the bench when I found it had just been painted.

sentences.japanese: 腰を下ろしてください。
